Study APPOINT-PNH (NCT04820530) is a single arm study in adults with PNH who were not previously treated with a complement inhibitor. This study enrolled a total of 40 adults with PNH (RBC clone size \ge 10\%), hemoglobin < 10 g/dL, and LDH > 1.5 times upper limit of normal (ULN). All 40 patients received FABHALTA 200 mg orally twice daily during the 24-week open-label core treatment period. Subsequently, patients were eligible to enroll in a 24-week treatment extension period and continue to receive FABHALTA, followed by a separate long-term extension study.

Serious adverse reactions in 4.8% in APPLY-PNH (pyelonephritis, urinary tract infection, COVID-19) and 5% in APPOINT-PNH (COVID-19, bacterial pneumonia). Serious infections due to encapsulated organisms and elevations in lipids (LDL and triglycerides) were reported.

detail.text: Boxed warning: Serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria. FABHALTA increases the risk of serious and life-threatening infections caused by encapsulated bacteria including Streptococcus pneumoniae, Neisseria meningitidis, and Haemophilus influenzae type B; vaccination is required at least 2 weeks prior to the first dose.

citations.quote: ## WARNING: SERIOUS INFECTIONS CAUSED BY ENCAPSULATED BACTERIA

FABHALTA increases the risk of serious and life-threatening infections caused by encapsulated bacteria, including *Streptococcus pneumoniae*, *Neisseria meningitidis*, and *Haemophilus influenzae* type B.

- Complete or update vaccination for encapsulated bacteria at least 2 weeks prior to the first dose of FABHALTA, unless the risks of delaying FABHALTA outweigh the risk of developing a serious infection. Comply with the most current Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommendations for vaccinations against encapsulated bacteria in patients receiving a complement inhibitor. (5.1)

detail.text: FABHALTA is available only through a restricted program under a REMS called FABHALTA REMS, to mitigate the risk of serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria.

citations.quote: FABHALTA is available only through a restricted program under a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) called FABHALTA REMS. (5.2)

In accordance with section 505-1 of FDCA, we have determined that a REMS is necessary for Fabhalta (iptacopan) to ensure the benefits of the drug outweigh the risk of serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria.
